rationale: Both describe increased/activated estrogen receptor (alpha vs. generic ER activity), differing in specificity.
Both describe population-level decline (size vs. trajectory), differing in specificity.
hERG channel blockade and inhibition of rapid delayed rectifier current (IKr) concern the same channel, but blockade and functional current inhibition are distinct processes.
Both concern the Smoothened receptor; antagonism and decreased relocation/activation are related but distinct events.
Both describe increased cell death, one specific to CNS neural cells.
Chromosomal aberrations and genomic instability are overlapping genomic damage endpoints with different specificity.
Both describe decreased T4/T3, in serum versus brain.
Both describe impaired memory function; one is learning and memory generally, other memory loss in a neurodegeneration context.
Both concern ACE2 but expression increase and increased shedding are distinct processes.
Both describe loss of ovarian follicle/oocyte pool, with differing specificity.
